html:
Vietlook Travel is a professional travel company offering high-quality Nha Trang Tours and other travel packages for international travelers in Vietnam.

We specialize in designing Nha Trang Tour itineraries that are clear, well-organized, and led by experienced English-speaking tour guides.

Our goal is to provide authentic local experiences, cultural discovery, and comfortable journeys for every guest on a Nha Trang Tour.

TOUR ITINERARY

DAY 1 CITY TOUR AND SUNSET CRUISE

Meals included Lunch and Dinner

  • 08:00 Pick up at hotel or Cam Ranh Airport.
  • Visit the main attractions of Nha Trang city:
  • Nha Trang Cathedral
  • Long Son Pagoda
  • Po Nagar Cham Towers
  • Hon Chong Promontory
  • Institute of Oceanography
  • In the evening, enjoy a sunset cruise on Nha Trang Bay.

DAY 2 ISLAND HOPPING EXPERIENCE

  • Meals included Breakfast Lunch and Dinner
  • Visit Hon Mun Island.
  • Scuba diving experience.
  • Mud bath and relaxation at Hon Tam Island.
  • In the evening, enjoy music and drinks at Sailing Club or Louisiane Brewhouse.

DAY 3 COUNTRYSIDE AND LOCAL CULTURE

  • Meals included Breakfast Lunch and Dinner
  • Visit a traditional ancient house.
  • Join a cooking class with a local family.
  • Experience traditional handicrafts such as mat weaving and conical hat making.
  • In the evening, visit Nha Trang Night Market for local food and souvenir shopping.

DAY 4 BA HO WATERFALLS AND AIRPORT TRANSFER

  • Meals included Breakfast and Lunch
  • Visit Ba Ho Waterfalls.
  • Walk through lush natural surroundings, swim in natural pools and enjoy fresh mountain air.
  • Return to the hotel and transfer to the airport.
  • End of the tour.

TOUR PRICE

35 US dollars per person.

TOUR INCLUSIONS

Transportation by air conditioned car.

Three nights accommodation at four star hotel, two persons per room.

Sunset cruise.

Canoe for island tours.

Three lunches and three dinners.

English speaking tour guide.

Bottled water during the tour.

TOUR EXCLUSIONS

Value added tax.

Personal expenses.

Services not mentioned in the itinerary.

CHILD POLICY

Children under one meter free of charge.

Children from one meter to one meter twenty nine charged seventy percent of adult price.

Children from one meter twenty nine and above charged adult price.
